BiblicalUsage: Shen is the place Samuel names when he sets up the stone Ebenezer between Mizpah and Shen. The stone says, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a stone set between two towns is the right kind of memorial, because the help of God deserves a marker. I hold that Ebenezer is the word I want over my own life.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
